Scope: sewage, storm water (with ponds and open channels), irrigation and potable water networks, 13.8 kV cable, street lighting, telecom ducts, and internal and external roads with asphalt and sidewalks.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. On 25-Oct-2026 the project is 99.05% complete against 99.93% planned, behind by 0.88% (SPI 0.99). This week gained 0.09% (42 of 48,045 man-hours, in Main Roads, Z02 and Z05), against 0.05% the week before. The revised completion date of 26-Sep-2026 has passed.

The revised completion date has passed, and the P6 finish slipped another week, to 80 days late. The contract completion was extended by two months to 26-Sep-2026 (CCO 2, approved 29-Jun-2026). The weekly report still forecasts completion on 15-Nov-2026, 50 days late. The P6 extract finishes the project on 15-Dec-2026 with −80 days of total float, a week later than the 08-Dec-2026 (−73 days) of the previous report. The remaining-activities list shows storm network catch-basin lines still to be excavated, laid, tested and backfilled in zones Z02, Z04, Z05, Z08 and Z11 and on Main Roads, plus testing and commissioning and as-built approvals, with all works finishing on 17-Nov-2026 in P6.

Revised quantities are far below the original BOQ for roadsThe revised BOQ, still marked "under review", sets each total equal to the installed quantity. For road works it is a small part of the original BOQ: asphalt wearing course 1,240 of 63,689 m³, precast kerb K1-D 15,100 of 187,209 m, kerb L1 1,972 of 123,805 m and interlock 1,576 of 59,537 m².
The sheet conflicts with the remaining-activities listThe P6 remaining-activities list of 25-Oct-2026 still has uPVC 300 mm and GRP 400 mm storm lines to excavate, lay, test and backfill in zones Z02, Z04, Z05, Z08 and Z11 and on Main Roads lines L-17, L-51 and L-58, and asphalt base course still to lay in Z05. The quantities above therefore overstate what is installed.
Medium-voltage works revised to zeroThe 13.8 kV cable (30,720 m in the original BOQ), its joints and terminations, the 950 m duct bank, the normally-open RMUs and the three street-lighting substations and RMUs all have a revised quantity of 0. They are left out of the table.

Data notes

  • Week number: the Milestones sheet, which stated contract week 116 on 18-Oct-2026, now shows a #VALUE! error. Counting contract weeks the same way gives 117 for 25-Oct-2026; whole weeks from site handover (818 days) would give 116, the number already used for last week's report.
  • Major Quantities is unchanged from 18-Oct-2026 and shows every item 100% installed, but the P6 remaining-activities list still has storm catch-basin lines to lay in five zones and on Main Roads, and asphalt base course in Z05.
  • The Physical-Chart Data sheet is unchanged and still shows 100% actual progress at 30-Sep-2026, against 99.05% in the Progress sheet on 25-Oct-2026.
  • Milestones: the weekly report gives the existing-condition survey as finished on 23-Jul-2025, while P6 lists it as finishing on 25-Oct-2026. Its other forecasts (February to July 2026) do not match P6 (25-Oct to 17-Nov-2026). "Complete steel structure erection for all blocks" does not fit an infrastructure project.
  • Manpower: the resources summary shows #VALUE! for planned and variance; the head count (1,092 manual, 92 non-manual) repeats last week's, and monthly actuals stop at January 2026. The HSE this-week figures also repeat last week's.
  • The Testing sheet still shows 0% for all systems, while P6 shows testing and commissioning started in several zones on 14-Oct-2026.
  • As-Built Tracker: the summary gives the remaining drawings as both 367 and 347, while 980 total less 655 submitted is 325.
  • Other uploads: the Progress Layouts PDF is dated 09-Aug-2026 and the Procurement Tracker 23-Aug-2026, so neither was used; the .rar archive has no text version. Of the five photos, the one that repeats another view was left out.
  • The invoice summary still shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists 24.
  • The workbook also reports cost-based progress (value-weighted) and labels it as planned and actual. This report uses physical % complete (man-hour weighted) only.
